title: When Is Berlin Busiest - Quick Summary
items: **Berlin does not fill up by season, it fills up in windows.** Most of them are three to ten days long and most are trade fairs at Messe Berlin in Charlottenburg, which visitors never think to check.

**The heavy dates between now and next autumn:** IFA 4 to 8 September 2026, InnoTrans 22 to 25 September, the marathon on 27 September, New Year's Eve, Grüne Woche 15 to 24 January 2027, the Berlinale 10 to 21 February, and ITB 16 to 18 March.

**City West goes first.** The Messe grounds sit in Charlottenburg, 25 minutes from Alexanderplatz on the S42 and S7, so Kurfürstendamm and the streets around Zoologischer Garten sell out before Mitte does.

**A fair week changes your hotel bill, not your Berlin.** Museums, restaurants and walking routes run exactly as normal. Only the marathon actually changes how you move, because the course closes roads across the centre for a morning.
**Mid-January is the trap.** It should be the cheapest fortnight of the year, and then Grüne Woche runs for ten public fair days. Aim for the first ten days of January or the very end of the month.
**If your dates are flexible, four or five days is usually enough of a shift.** These windows are short and they rarely overlap, so a small move steps around the expensive one completely.
